text: We recommended that, in general, any drug or pharmaceutical preparation which has an action on the central nervous system and is liable to produce physical or psychological dependence should be controlled. As an interim and urgent measure, the Secretary of State for the Home Department, on the recommendation of the Poisons Board, has made Rules under which certain substances having an action on the central nervous system are included in a new list of substances which may be sold by retail only on prescription. The Secretary of State for the Home Department should be responsible for acquiring which substances. He should so control.
